lines.intro: Advanced X-ray imaging systems with proven expertise in diagnostic technology.

products.name: INNOVISION EXII (Ceiling Type-ELIN T5)
products._source: MEDIVIS Product Showcase 1.5, slides 4-6 and 10 (Elin-T5); list image = slide 4 ceiling photo; feature images from DK '장비 사진/New T5'
products.tagline: Full Auto-Positioning & Integrated Touchscreen LCD Handlebar.
products.target: Premium centers requiring high-volume automated exams & spine stitching.

features.label: Auto-Positioning
features.title: One-Touch Preset Alignment
features.text: One-touch motorized drive aligns the ceiling tube and detector stand seamlessly to pre-programmed clinical exam angles.

features.label: Bucky Synchronization
features.title: Motorized Tube Tracking
features.text: Motorized synchronization locks the X-ray tube focal spot with vertical table/wall Bucky movements for zero-effort centermost alignment.

features.label: Wholespine Auto-Stitching
features.title: Long Bone & Spine Imaging
features.text: Automated multi-shot image stitching captures full-spine and long-leg studies in standing positions with high diagnostic precision.

products._highlights_source: DK 'Design strategy-gui.pdf' (장비 사진/New T5), pp.4-7, 13-14, 23-25; Korean points translated, competitor research and undecided A/B/C concepts left out

highlights.title: THU – Touchscreen Handlebar GUI
highlights.lead: Bold & Minimalism × Bezelless: a simple, premium style that makes the screen feel wider.
items: A bezelless design that makes the screen look larger than it is.
A deep background that blends seamlessly with the bezel.
Rich, realistic images of the system’s movement.
Preview, Control and Status bar areas, with functions grouped by category and clear, dimensional control buttons.
Restrained shapes and colors, color-grouped information, and emphasis only on highlighted controls.

highlights.title: ELUI – Imaging Software
highlights.lead: A modular interface built around the image.
items: Clearly separated Tools, Image and Status bar areas for a maximized image view.
